title: How to import residents from a spreadsheet
music: About fifty seconds of original, calm instrumental background music for a friendly how-to video. Warm West African flavour: soft hand percussion, light shaker, clean guitar picking, mellow keys. Relaxed tempo around 96 BPM, even dynamics so a voice can sit on top, no vocals, a soft resolved ending.
vo: Most estates already keep their residents in a spreadsheet. You don't need to retype it. Here's how to import it.
Open Households in the admin sidebar, then click Import CSV, and choose your file.
Check the preview. It shows how many rows are ready, and explains any that need fixing.
Click Import. Your households appear straight away.
Each household gets a temporary four-digit PIN, shown once, with a download so you can share them privately.
Tip: you can download the template first, and paste your data into it.
